reader.decision: Approve the manual ack with prefetch=CONCURRENCY, cancel_futures=True on shutdown, and LANTERN_DRAIN_SECONDS=15. Ask Billing whether meter.internal dedups on `ref`, in parallel with shipping.
reader.decision_reason: The message traces the loss to auto_ack=True, where the broker forgets a job before the work is done. Manual ack fixes that and also covers OOM kills and node loss. The longer grace period does neither and slows every deploy. The double-billing risk is narrow and Billing can settle it.

reconstruction.problem: After a deploy of lantern-jobs, a few uploads get no thumbnail and no error. The worker consumes with auto_ack=True and no prefetch, so RabbitMQ deletes each job on delivery. On SIGTERM the drain deadline (60s) is longer than the pod's 20s grace period. Queued jobs also keep starting after SIGTERM because pool.shutdown(wait=False) keeps queued work.
reconstruction.what_breaks: Kubelet sends SIGKILL at 14:02:30. Four jobs (u-88217, u-88218, u-88219, u-88221) die mid-render. No thread can log an error and the broker has no copy, so the upload page shows a placeholder.
reconstruction.fix: In consume.py, set auto_ack=False and basic_qos(prefetch_count=CONCURRENCY). Ack after handle succeeds, via add_callback_threadsafe. Nack with requeue=True on an exception. In lifecycle.py, use pool.shutdown(wait=False, cancel_futures=True). Set LANTERN_DRAIN_SECONDS to 15, below the 20s grace period. The alternative is to keep auto_ack and set the grace period to 90s with a drain of 80s.
reconstruction.cost: A pod killed between record_usage and the ack redelivers the job, so the thumbnail may be billed twice. Whether meter.internal dedups on `ref` is unverified, because its code is outside the repository. The alternative costs slower deploys and still loses jobs on OOM or node loss.

follow_up_questions: Does meter.internal dedup on `ref`? If not, is a possible double bill acceptable until Billing fixes it, or must record_usage be made idempotent first?
reader.closing_answer: I approve the manual ack with prefetch and cancelled queue. I ask the Billing team to confirm meter.internal dedups on `ref`. If the consumer code cannot change this week, I use the longer grace period as a stopgap.
